segments.an4.213:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an4.213:1.3: Kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, akataññutā akataveditā [akataññutāakataveditāya (sī.)]– imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an4.213:2.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an4.213:2.3: Kāyasucaritena, vacīsucaritena, manosucaritena, kataññutākataveditā [kataññutākataveditāya (sī.)]– imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.
